contents.text:
I'm working out how to frame the selling pitch for this visitor, who asked for everything. I'll keep it a bit longer than usual, conversational with a few short paragraphs and no lists, opening with a good morning and explaining it's a website agent that answers customers around the clock and knows the business.

I'm weighing which options to offer the visitor, leaning toward a demo as the suggested choice, with a quote through Louis as another and a "not now" as a third. I'm keeping the pitch on Louis as a software engineer from Malmesbury and avoiding any claim that the agent books appointments.

I'm settling on the wrap-up for the visitor now, with a demo as the suggested option and a quote through Louis plus a "not now" as alternatives, and I'll keep it conversational and free of any mention of the plan pricing.

Good morning, and welcome! I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. I'm the proof of what he builds, so you're talking to it right now.

It's a website with an agent in its corner. The agent answers your customers day and night, and it knows your business from plain files you can read and change. It can point someone to the right room or page, show a booking request as a clear card, and ask before it sends anything. Every answer shows what it cost to give.

Every quote is made on request, after a short call with Louis. There's no price list, because it depends on your business. Louis is from Malmesbury in the Swartland, and he builds the site, hosts it and keeps it running. He has been a .NET programmer for more than twenty years, and he made this framework himself.

Want to see one at work for a business like yours?

arguments.question: Shall I show you one working?

choices.label: Show me a demo
choices.why: An agent at work for a business like yours.

choices.label: Ask about my business
choices.why: Tell me what you do and I'll show you what it would look like.
